solo-leveling.about: Weakest-to-strongest climbs, dungeons and levelling, and the Korean web novels and webtoons Solo Leveling came from.

picks.why: The closest new one, also from a Korean web novel: Grid, an unlucky low-level player in the VR game Satisfy, lands a legendary class and grinds his way up. Its Hindi dub on Crunchyroll came out alongside Japan's broadcast.
The nearest premise to Jinwoo's double dungeon: Hajime, the weakest student summoned to another world, is left for dead at the bottom of a dungeon and climbs out as the strongest.
Another Korean webtoon hit: Bam enters a tower where every floor is a deadly test and climbs it to find his friend Rachel.
A weak, low-ranked dragon hunter gains the power of his future self and goes after the strongest dragons.
Summoned as the weakest of four heroes and framed soon after he arrives, Naofumi builds his strength from nothing, on his own terms.
For the moments where Jinwoo finally shows how strong he is: Cid hides overwhelming power and steps out of the shadows when it counts.
The game side of Solo Leveling: a gamer who masters broken games takes on a VR world's toughest monsters and levels up through hard-won fights.
Dungeon crawling and levels done straight: Bell Cranell starts at Level 1 in a city built around a monster-filled dungeon and climbs faster than anyone.
A late bloomer like E-rank Jinwoo: Kafka, 32 and stuck cleaning up after monster fights, gains monstrous power overnight and joins the people who fight them.
A long underdog climb: Asta, born with no magic in a world where everyone has it, outworks everyone on his way to becoming Wizard King.
Curses instead of gates, but the same ranked hunters, monster-fighting organisations and huge power fights.
A Korean webtoon of fights that keep escalating: a martial-arts tournament that turns into a war of borrowed gods.

death-note.about: Mind games, cat-and-mouse thrillers and morally grey geniuses, like Light against L.

picks.why: The closest match: Lelouch gains the power to make anyone obey one command and leads a masked rebellion against an empire, a genius anti-hero who plans ten moves ahead like Light.
The best slow-burn cat and mouse: a brilliant surgeon saves a boy who grows up into a serial killer, then hunts him across Germany.
A quiet mastermind: Ayanokoji hides how clever he is in a school ruled by points and outplans everyone from the back row.
Children in an idyllic orphanage find out what it really is and plot an escape under the nose of a caretaker who is always a step ahead.
Death Note's big question as a police thriller: a system reads people's minds to judge criminals before they act, and the detectives have to decide whether to trust it.
The criminal genius is the hero: William James Moriarty plots against Britain's corrupt nobility while Sherlock Holmes closes in.
A mystery against the clock: a man is sent back to his childhood and has to stop the murders that took his classmates.
Mind games through gambling: at a school where students rank by their bets, Yumeko reads every opponent and keeps raising the stakes.
Five friends in a game built to make them betray each other over a debt, and the lead is far more calculating than he looks.
A self-proclaimed mad scientist finds he can send messages to the past and is pulled into a conspiracy where every change has a price.
Twelve people with diaries that predict the future fight to the death for the right to become god.
The lighter pick: two genius student council leaders turn a crush into a battle of wits, each scheming to make the other confess first.

kimetsu-no-yaiba.about: Swords against monsters, found family and big animated fights, much of it set in old Japan.

picks.why: The closest pick: Yuji swallows a cursed finger and joins the sorcerers who hunt curses, with the same mix of brutal fights, teachers worth following and found family.
Devil hunters instead of demon slayers: Denji merges with his chainsaw devil and joins Public Safety to hunt devils.
Swords against monsters in old Japan: the death-row ninja Gabimaru is sent to an island of monsters to find the elixir of life in exchange for a pardon.
Feudal Japan and demons: Hyakkimaru, whose body was traded to demons before he was born, wins back a piece of himself with every demon he kills.
The classic sword-and-spirit fighter: Ichigo gains a Soul Reaper's powers and cuts down hollows with a giant sword.
Soldiers fight man-eating giants with blades, and like Tanjiro, Eren sets out after a monster takes his family from him.
The original demon-hunting adventure in feudal Japan: a half-demon and a schoolgirl hunt down the shards of a sacred jewel.
Rin learns he is Satan's son and trains as an exorcist, fighting demons with a sword that seals his own demon power.
Special fire brigades fight people who turn into flaming monsters, with a hero whose feet blaze like rockets.
Another underdog with a big heart: Asta, born without magic, swings anti-magic swords on his way to becoming Wizard King.
A monster-fighting corps and a hero who is part monster himself: Kafka gains a kaiju's power and joins the Defense Force anyway.
Darker, with heavy losses: a young swordsman joins a band of assassins fighting a corrupt empire.

youkoso-jitsuryoku-shijou-shugi-no-kyous.about: Hidden geniuses, school power games and mind games where the quiet one is always three steps ahead.

picks.why: The closest in mood: a school run on gambling, where a calm transfer student reads every opponent and exposes every cheat.
Tatsuya is ranked in the lowest tier at an elite magic school yet is secretly stronger and smarter than anyone, much like Ayanokoji.
A student genius who manipulates everyone around him: Lelouch leads a masked rebellion against an empire while attending school.
A cynical loner who reads people better than they read themselves, untangling his classmates' problems in a school club.
School mind games played for laughs: two genius student council leaders scheme to make the other confess first.
Five friends in a game built to make them betray each other, and the lead is far more calculating than he looks.
A brilliant high schooler hides behind a model-student face while running the deadliest game in Japan.
Another lead who hides his real power behind an ordinary face, played half for laughs.
The lowest-ranked class at an elite school, written off by the system, gets a year to kill their teacher and grows through it.
Elite high school students locked inside their school are forced into a killing game, with trials to unmask each killer.
Mind games with real stakes: a broke young man is pulled into high-stakes gambling where every bluff could ruin him.
Gifted children outthink the adults who control them and plan an escape under their noses.

black-clover-tv.about: Underdogs who never stop training, magic and power systems, and squads of rivals with one big dream.

picks.why: Deku is born without powers in a world where nearly everyone has one, inherits a hero's power and trains to be the greatest; he and Asta could be brothers.
The village outcast who wants to lead it: Naruto's dream of becoming Hokage is Asta's Wizard King dream, rival and all.
The closest match for the magic and the squads: Natsu and his guild take on jobs and dark guilds with a lot of heart and loud fights.
A boy born with no magic in a world built on it punches his way through magic school, Asta's story played as comedy.
A kingdom of knights and magic powers, and a band of disgraced heroes setting out to clear their names.
Magic, dungeons and a friendship at the centre: Aladdin and Alibaba clear magical dungeons across a world of kingdoms.
Gon sets out to become a Hunter and find his father, with a power system as inventive as the grimoires.
Squads and captains with their own powers, like the Magic Knights, and a hot-headed hero with a giant sword.
A kind-hearted hero who never stops training, and an elite corps whose strongest fighters lead it, like the Magic Knight captains.
A crew of misfits chasing one huge dream, with the same loyalty and an endless line of rivals.
Another underdog climb: Jinwoo, the weakest hunter, gets the power to level up and goes from E-rank to the top.
A newer shonen with a school of fighters, ranked sorcerers and big power battles.

tokyo-revengers.about: Going back in time to change the past, and delinquents who fight for their friends.

picks.why: The closest: a man sent back to his school days has to change the past to save someone, just like Takemichi.
After a childhood friend's death, Shinpei goes home to his island and gets caught in a time loop, trying again and again to save her and his friends.
Subaru goes back to a set point every time he dies and has to find the one path where everyone lives.
Messages to the past change the present, and every change costs someone; the best-known time-travel anime.
Letters from her future self ask Naho to change the past and save a classmate before it's too late.
Delinquents who protect their town: Haruka Sakura joins Furin High, a school of fighters who guard its streets.
A bullied teen wakes up in a second, stronger body and gets pulled into school gangs and street fights.
A former gang leader becomes a teacher and fights for his students; delinquent life with a big heart.
Colour gangs, a headless rider and urban legends on the streets of Ikebukuro.
Ash Lynx, a New York gang leader, uncovers the conspiracy behind a drug called Banana Fish; darker and more grown-up.
The classic delinquent hero: a street fighter who dies saving a child comes back as a spirit detective.
